dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute isolated ocular flutter (saccadic oscillation disorder), most consistent with an idiopathic or postinfectious autoimmune process

ALTERNATIVE: Paraneoplastic opsoclonus–myoclonus syndrome, particularly neuroblastoma-associated disease

ALTERNATIVE: Autoimmune encephalitis-associated ocular flutter

ALTERNATIVE: Early demyelinating brainstem/cerebellar disease despite currently normal MRI and CSF
